charts.title: United States: electricity net generation shares by source
charts.notes: Annual percent of U.S. electricity net generation. Coal, natural gas, nuclear, conventional hydroelectric, wind, petroleum, and TOTAL.ELETPUS are all-sectors series in the EIA Monthly Energy Review bulk file. Solar is TOTAL.SOTEPUS (Solar Electricity Net Generation), which includes estimated small-scale solar. The total is TOTAL.ELETPUS plus TOTAL.SOTEPUS minus TOTAL.SOETPUS when both solar series are published for that year, so small-scale solar is included once. Other is that total minus the named sources published for that year. An NA source is omitted and is not subtracted. Shares are rounded half up to 3 decimals and can sum to a number other than 100.
